long_run.limits: Automatic same-time overlap joining. Identities across20minutes are unverified; not jersey numbers or TOI. SAM3 masks can drift or persist behind occlusion.

long_video.source: Exact cached inference JPEGs, each shared overlap checked byte-for-byte. Delivery resized; inference used1920x1080.

limits: New temporal interval from a previously reused recording; not a new independent game.
Four initially visible floor players sampled once per second; not continuous full-game identity accuracy.
YOLO-assisted boxes may favor detector-supported methods; boxes and identities were visually reviewed.
Uncertain and out-of-view observations are excluded; no interpolation or off-camera position inference.
Manually observed jersey hints are for this audit, not validated production roster identities.

supplementary_audit.limits: Four predetermined players in two 30-second intervals. Sparse one-second samples, not dense every-frame MOT ground truth. Supplementary labels sealed after inference started but before prediction review. No parameter tuning on this audit.

results.reference_bias: Boxes were assisted by these proposals; this baseline is not independently annotated.

fresh_detection_audit.limits: A correlated temporal sample from a reused tracking recording. YOLO proposals assist localization and can favor that baseline. Partial-player boxes describe visible extent, not inferred hidden body.

fresh_detection_baseline_control.reason: The primary audit used the tracking proposal threshold0.1. Also show the detector confidence0.65 frozen on October18, avoiding an unfair comparison against only low-confidence proposals. No threshold search or new inference.
fresh_detection_baseline_control.reference_bias: The new boxes were assisted by YOLO proposals; this comparison is not independently annotated.

limitations: Reused recordings and assistant-reviewed, correlated references; not an independent benchmark.
Sparse identity pairs and sampled transitions are distinct from continuous identity accuracy.
Track fragments are not validated roster identities, time on floor or metric distance.
